About Guruvayur Live

Guruvayur Live (guruvayurlive.in) is an independent, community-driven digital resource and travel portal dedicated to providing accurate, up-to-date, and heartfelt guidance for devotees visiting the historic Guruvayur Sree Krishna Temple in Thrissur, Kerala.

Our Purpose

Known affectionately as Bhuloka Vaikuntham (Heaven on Earth), Guruvayur attracts millions of pilgrims annually from every corner of India and the global diaspora. Navigating pooja timings, complex dress codes, darshan lines, marriage registration, and accommodation can often be overwhelming, especially for first-time visitors.

Our goal is to organize this vital knowledge in one seamless, fast-loading, mobile-friendly destination:

  • Live & Daily Pooja Schedules: Detailed step-by-step timetables from early morning Nirmalyam to night Thrippuka.
  • Verified Entry Regulations: Clear dos and don'ts covering dress codes, electronic item cloakrooms, and queue rules.
  • Visual Gallery Chronicle: High-resolution curated photo collections of festival processions, temple architecture, and the Punnathurkotta Elephant Sanctuary.
  • Pilgrim Travel Essentials: Unbiased guides on nearby lodges near East and West Nada, train/flight connections, and wedding hall bookings.

Independent Informational Disclaimer

Please note that guruvayurlive.in is an independent educational and travel resource. We are not the administrative body of the Guruvayur Devaswom Board. To book official e-darshan tokens, conduct vazhipadus (special offerings), or reserve official Devaswom guest houses, devotees must always visit the official portal: guruvayurdevaswom.in.
